## 1. Load Functions

```{r, load-functions}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Source Functions ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# source("code/01_format_crop.system_kc_param_&_soil_param.R") # Used for data formatting
source("code/01_function_get_Peff.R")
# source("code/02_function_get_et0.R") # Used in case of weekly et0 data to convert to daily et0
source("code/03_function_expand_kc.R")
source("code/04_function_get_budget.R")
quantile_df <- function(x, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)) {
    tibble(quantile = probs, value = quantile(x, probs, na.rm = TRUE))
}
```

## 2. A List of Parameters & Input Data for Water Budget Function

```{r, set_param_budget, echo = TRUE}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Provide Input Parameters & data ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
p.list <- list(rain = rain,
               crop.param = crop.param,
               soil.param = soil.param,
               # et0.timestep = "weekly", # weekly/daily
               # et0.input = et0.week.imd, # For "weekly", choose: et0.week.imd
               et0.timestep = "daily", # weekly/daily
               et0.input = et0.daily, # For "daily", choose: et0.daily
               kc.doy.crops = kc.doy.crops,
               kc_no_crop = list(summer = 0.005, kr = 0.2),
               soil.type = "red",
               CN = 85,
               sm.init = 0.5)
met.forcing <- get_peff_et0(p = p.list)
```

## 3. Run Water Budget Function

Function is run in parallel for various cropping systems

```{r, get_budget, eval = FALSE, include = TRUE}

# 1. Define the number of cores
num_cores <- parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE) # Use only available Physical Cores

# 2. Create a cluster using the 'spawn' method (default for makeCluster, especially on Windows, or can be specified with 'type')
# The 'fork' method is the default on Linux/macOS and 'spawn' on Windows. 
# Running into errors using 'fork' method, for example with mclaply:
  # [UIFontDescriptor initialize] may have been in progress in another thread when fork() was called.

# Explicitly use "PSOCK" cluster type, which uses 'spawn' semantics across platforms.
cl <- makeCluster(num_cores, type = "PSOCK") 

# 3. Export necessary variables/packages to the cluster nodes
# When using 'spawn', child processes start fresh and don't inherit the parent's environment.
clusterExport(cl, varlist = c("p.list", "met.forcing", "get_budget", "get_kc", "quantile_df"), envir = environment()) 

# 4. Explicitly load the correct package on each node of the cluster. 
clusterEvalQ(cl, {library(tidyverse); library(ggpubr)})

# 5. Use pblapply with the cluster object 'cl'
budget <- pblapply(crop.systems.ls, get_budget, cl = cl, p = p.list, ts = met.forcing, get_kc = get_kc)

# 6. Stop the cluster when done
stopCluster(cl)
names(budget) <- names(crop.systems.ls)
save(budget, file = "output/water_budgets/Budget.Rdata")

# For debugging:
# cs <- crop.system.ls[[15]]; p = p.list; ts = met.forcing; get_kc = get_kc
# for (i in 1:length(crop.systems.ls)) {
#   print(i)
#   budget <- lapply(crop.systems.ls[i], get_budget, p = p.list, ts = met.forcing, get_kc = get_kc)
# }
```

## 4. Water Budgeting Outputs for Various Cropping Systems

### 1. Water Supply-Demand of Cropping Systems - Annual Perspective 

```{r, plot-summary, echo = FALSE, fig.align = 'center', fig.cap = 'Annual Climatology of Water Supply Demand for cropping systems. Recharge is depicted in negative terms of the water consumption axis.', eval = TRUE, include = TRUE}

load(file = "output/water_budgets/Budget.Rdata")
crop.systems <- read.csv(file = "data/processed/06_crop.systems.csv", header = TRUE)
# Debugging for crop kc

# Save daily outputs ----
kcr.all.ls <- lapply(budget, function(x) {return(x$kcr)})
kcr.all <- dplyr::bind_rows(kcr.all.ls, .id = "crop.systems") %>% 
  left_join(crop.systems, by = "crop.systems") %>%
  relocate(names(crop.systems), .after = crop.systems)
kcr.yr.sum <- kcr.all %>% group_by(crop.systems, rotation) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(kcr = sum(kcr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(rotation)
# Kcr by rotation matches well with Excel
kc.crops.l.ls.budget <- lapply(budget, function(x) {
  x.l <- x$kc.crops.df %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(-date, -doy), names_to = "crop.rotation", values_to = "kc") %>% subset(!crop.rotation %in% "no_crop")
  return(x.l)})
kc.crops.budget <- dplyr::bind_rows(kc.crops.l.ls.budget, .id = "crop.systems") %>% 
  arrange()

# Save daily outputs ----
ts.all.ls <- lapply(budget, function(x) {return(x$ts)})
ts.all <- dplyr::bind_rows(ts.all.ls, .id = "crop.systems") %>% 
  left_join(crop.systems, by = "crop.systems") %>%
  relocate(names(crop.systems), .after = crop.systems)
write.csv(ts.all, file = "output/water_budgets/01_water.budget.daily.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# Save only one year (the first) to share a lighter file
ts.all.first.yr <- subset(ts.all, year == min(unique(ts.all$year)))
write.csv(ts.all.first.yr, file = paste0("output/water_budgets/02_water.budget.daily.", min(unique(ts.all$year)),".csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ts.all.first.yr %>% group_by(crop.systems) %>% dplyr::summarise(irri = sum(irri.needed, na.rm = TRUE))

# Save annual outputs ----
sum.yr.all.ls <- lapply(budget, function(x) {return(x$sum.yr)})
sum.yr.all <- dplyr::bind_rows(sum.yr.all.ls, .id = "crop.systems") %>% 
  left_join(crop.systems, by = "crop.systems") %>%
  relocate(names(crop.systems), .after = crop.systems)
write.csv(sum.yr.all, file = "output/water_budgets/03_water.budget.annual.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save summary outputs ----
summary.yr.ls <- lapply(budget, function(x) {return(x$summary.yr)})

summary.crop <- dplyr::bind_rows(summary.yr.ls, .id = "crop.systems") 
summary.crop <- summary.crop %>% 
  left_join(crop.systems, by = "crop.systems")  %>%
  relocate(names(crop.systems), .after = crop.systems)

summ.qs <- summary.crop %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = quantile, values_from = value) %>%
  arrange(var, mean) %>%
  mutate(var.plot = forcats::fct_recode(factor(var), "Precipitation (mm)" = "P", "Precipitation - Recharge (mm)" = "Peff", "-Recharge (mm)" = "Q", "AET (mm)" = "aet", "Crop ET (mm)" = "aet.crop", "ET:Effective Rainfall" = "aet.to.Peff", "Crop ET Supply:Demand" = "aet.to.etc.crop", "NPWR (mm)" = "balance", "Potential ET (mm)" = "et0", "Potential Crop ET (mm)" = "etc", "etc.crop (mm)" = "etc.crop", "Pumping (mm)" = "irrigation", "Recharge (mm)" = "recharge", "% Runoff" = "runoff.percent", "% Soil Moisture" = "sm.percent"))

# arrange factor levels in the order of 'Balance' 
summ.qs.balance <- summ.qs %>% subset(var %in% c("balance")) %>%
  arrange(mean) %>%
  mutate(crop.systems = factor(crop.systems, crop.systems)) # this line reorders the factor in the same order
summ.qs$crop.systems <- factor(summ.qs$crop.systems,           levels=levels(summ.qs.balance$crop.systems))

save(summ.qs, file = "output/water_budgets/04_summ.qs.Rdata")

summ.qs_order <- subset(summ.qs, var == "balance") %>% arrange(desc(mean))
summ.qs.wide <- summ.qs %>% 
  select(-c(1, 3:6, var.plot, `0.025`, `0.5`, `0.975`)) %>%
  mutate(mean = round(mean)) %>% 
  # Ordering by decreasing order of Net Recharge/Balance
  arrange(match(crop.systems, summ.qs_order$crop.systems)) %>%
  # subset(var == "aet") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "crop.systems", values_from = c("mean")) %>%
  arrange(match(var, c("P", "Peff", "Q", "et0", "etc", "etc.crop", "aet", "aet.crop", "recharge", "irrigation", "balance", "aet.to.Peff", "aet.to.etc.crop", "runoff.percent", "sm.percent")))
write.csv(summ.qs.wide, file = "output/water_budgets/06_water.budget.annual.climatology_mean_wide.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Plot Annual Climatology of Water Supply Demand & NPWR 
yr.vars.to.plot.1 <- c("Recharge (mm)", "Pumping (mm)", "Crop ET Supply:Demand")
summ.qs.select.1 <- summ.qs %>% subset(var.plot %in% yr.vars.to.plot.1) %>%
    mutate(var.plot = factor(var.plot, levels = c("Pumping (mm)", "Recharge (mm)", "Crop ET Supply:Demand")))
  
p.yr.budget.base <- ggplot(summ.qs.select.1,
       aes(y = crop.systems)) +
  facet_grid(. ~ var.plot, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("Rainfed" = "yellow3", "Irrigated" = "skyblue")) +
  ylab("Cropping System") +
  theme_baseR + theme(legend.title = element_blank())

p.yr.budget.median <- p.yr.budget.base +  
  geom_col(aes(x = `0.5`, fill = Irrigation)) + xlab("Median (95 CI)") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmax = `0.975`, xmin = `0.025`), width = 0.2, color = "gray30")
ggsave(plot = p.yr.budget.median, file = paste0("figures/water_budgets/01_annual_climatology_water_budget_median.jpg"), width = 9, height = 4)

p.yr.budget.mean <- p.yr.budget.base +  
  geom_col(aes(x = mean, fill = Irrigation)) + xlab("Mean (95 CI)") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmax = `0.975`, xmin = `0.025`), width = 0.2, color = "gray30")
print(p.yr.budget.mean)
ggsave(plot = p.yr.budget.mean, file = paste0("figures/water_budgets/02_annual_climatology_water_budget_mean.jpg"), width = 9, height = 4)
```

### 3. Water Budget of Cropping Systems - Monthly Perspective

```{r, monthly-supply-demand, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.cap='Monthly climatalogy of water fluxes (median + 95 CI) for various cropping systems. Note that recharge is depicted in negative terms on the water consumption axis. Cropping systems are organised in order of increasing annual irrigation, followed by decreasing annual recharge.', include=TRUE}

# Plot monthly----
# When the functions in .fns return a data frame, you typically get a
  # "packed" data frame back

add_clim.mo <- function (x) {
  sum.mo <- x[["sum.mo"]] %>%
    mutate(plot.recharge = -recharge,
           plot.irri = if_else(irrigation == 0, NA, irrigation),
           plot.aet = if_else(aet == 0, NA, aet),
           plot.etc = if_else(etc == 0, NA, etc))
  
  clim.mo <- sum.mo %>%
  select(-year) %>%
  pivot_longer(-month, names_to = "var", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(var, month) %>%
  reframe(quantile_df(value)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "quantile", values_from = "value") %>%
  rename(q025 = `0.025`, q975 = `0.975`, median = `0.5`)
  x[["clim.mo"]] <- clim.mo
  return(x)
}
budget <- lapply(budget, add_clim.mo)
# Add crop system names
clim.mo.ls <- lapply(budget, function(x) {return(x$clim.mo)})
clim.crop <- dplyr::bind_rows(clim.mo.ls, .id = "crop.systems") 
clim.crop <- clim.crop %>% 
  left_join(crop.systems, by = "crop.systems") %>%
  relocate(names(crop.systems), .after = crop.systems)
# Save monthly outputs ----
write.csv(clim.crop, file = "output/water_budgets/07_water.budget.monthly.climatology.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Select vars to plot
mo.vars.to.plot.1 <- c("plot.recharge", "plot.aet", "plot.etc", "plot.irri") 
                       
clim.crop.select.1 <- clim.crop %>% 
  subset(var %in% mo.vars.to.plot.1) %>%
  mutate(var_f = fct_recode(var, "Potential Crop ET" = "plot.etc",
                            "Actual ET" = "plot.aet", 
                            "-Recharge" = "plot.recharge",
                            "Pumping" = "plot.irri"),
         var_f = factor(var_f, levels = c("Potential Crop ET",
                            "Actual ET", "-Recharge", "Pumping"))) %>%
  # To order cropping systems by least irrigation, joining total annual irrigation
  left_join(subset(clim.crop, var %in% "irrigation") %>% group_by(crop.systems) %>% dplyr::summarise(irri.median.sum = sum(median, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"), by = join_by(crop.systems)) %>%
  left_join(subset(clim.crop, var %in% "recharge") %>% group_by(crop.systems) %>% dplyr::summarise(recharge.median.sum = sum(median, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"), by = join_by(crop.systems)) %>%
  arrange(irri.median.sum, desc(recharge.median.sum)) %>%
  mutate(crop.systems = fct_reorder(crop.systems, 1:n()))

p.monthly.budget.base <- ggplot(clim.crop.select.1,
                            aes(x = month)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q025, ymax = q975, group = var_f, fill = var_f), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median, group = var_f, color = var_f), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = as.character(1:12), limits = c(1, 12)) +
  theme_baseR +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 0, linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(crop.systems ~ . , scales = "fixed")
p.monthly.budget <- p.monthly.budget.base +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank()) +
  ylab("Water Consumption (mm) (median + 95 CI)") + xlab("Month") +
  ggtitle("Monthly Water Use & Recharge from Various Cropping Systems in Billikere (1970:2022)")
print(p.monthly.budget)
ggsave(plot = p.monthly.budget, file = paste0("figures/water_budgets/04_monthly_climatology_water_budget_median.jpg"), width = 11.52 , height = 7.49)
```

### 4. Blue Water Potential of Cropping Systems - Monthly Perspective

```{r, mo-npwr, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.cap='Monthly climatalogy of NPWR (median + 95 CI) for cropping systems. Positive values are depicted in blue (Blue Water), negative values in red. Cropping systems are organised in decreasing order of annual Blue Water potential.', include=TRUE}

clim.crop.select.2 <- clim.crop %>%
  subset(var %in% "balance") %>%
  mutate(var_f = fct_recode(var, "NPWR" = "balance"), 
         crop.systems = factor(crop.systems, levels = levels(clim.crop.select.1$crop.systems)))   

clim.crop.select.2 <- clim.crop.select.2 %>%
  left_join(clim.crop.select.2 %>% group_by(crop.systems) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(balance.median.sum = sum(median, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),  by = join_by(crop.systems)) %>%
  arrange(desc(balance.median.sum))

# p.monthly.npwr <- p.monthly.budget.base %+% clim.crop.select.2 +
#   theme(legend.position = "none") + 
#   scale_color_manual(values=c("blue")) + scale_fill_manual(values=c("skyblue")) +
#   ylab("NPWR (mm)") + xlab("Month") +
#   ggtitle("Monthly NPWR for Various Crop Systems in Billikere")
# print(p.monthly.npwr)
# ggsave(plot = p.monthly.npwr, file = paste0("figures/water_budgets/water_budget_monthly_select.1_crop.systems.jpg"), width = 11.52, height = 7.49)

p.monthly.npwr <- ggplot(mutate(clim.crop.select.2, above_axis = median >= 0),
                            aes(x = month)) +
  facet_wrap(crop.systems ~ . , scales = "fixed") +
  # Ribbon for area below the horizontal axis (y=0)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmin(q025, 0), ymax = 0, fill = "Below axis"), alpha = 0.5) +
  # Ribbon for area above the horizontal axis (y=0)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = pmax(q975, 0), fill = "Above axis"), alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_baseR +
  # Manually define the colors for the fill aesthetic
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Below axis" = "lightpink", "Above axis" = "skyblue")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median, color = above_axis, group = 1), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = as.character(1:12), limits = c(1, 12)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 0, linewidth = 0.2) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  ylab("NPWR (mm) (median + 95 CI)") + xlab("Month") +
  ggtitle("Monthly Blue Water Potential for Various Cropping Systems in Billikere (1970:2022)")
print(p.monthly.npwr)
ggsave(plot = p.monthly.npwr, file = paste0("figures/water_budgets/05_monthly_climatology_npwr_median.jpg"), width = 11.52, height = 7.49)
```
